description:
The OpenJDK 21 packages provide the OpenJDK 21 Java Runtime Environment and the OpenJDK 21 Java Software Development Kit.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * JDK: Improve Resource Resolving (CVE-2026-60589)
  * JDK: Enhance HTTP Connections (CVE-2026-61308)
  * JDK: Enhance TLS server (CVE-2026-70907)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
solution:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
title: Moderate: java-21-openjdk security update
